rows.Origin:
Bred by Tom Carruth (United States, 1996).
Introduced in United States by Spring Hill Nurseries in 1997 as 'George Burns'.
Introduced in Australia by Swane's Nursery/Swane Bros Pty Ltd in 2019 as 'Glamourpuss'.
rows.Bloom: Yellow, red stripes, cream stripes, pink stripes. Strong, citrus, fruity fragrance. 26 to 40 petals. Average diameter 4". Large, full (26-40 petals), cluster-flowered, in small clusters bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Medium, armed with thorns / prickles, compact, upright. Large, matte, dark green foliage.

Height: 30" to 42" (75 to 105cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 3b through 10b. Can be used for beds and borders, container rose, cut flower or garden. Disease susceptibility: susceptible to blackspot . Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that.
